transcript.content: Hi, this is Sophia Silva. I have a reservation with confirmation number H8Q05L, and I'd like to cancel my flight and receive a full refund.
I'll look up your reservation right away.

I can see your reservation. To process the cancellation, I need to know your reason. What is the reason for cancelling?

- **Change of plan**
- **Airline cancelled the flight**
- **Health or weather** (you do have travel insurance on this reservation)
- **Other**
It's a change of plan. I want to cancel and receive a full refund—if a full refund isn't available, then I don't want to cancel at all.

Unfortunately, this reservation doesn't qualify for cancellation under our policy. Here's why none of the eligibility criteria apply:

- The booking was made on May 3 (more than 24 hours ago)
- The reason is change of plan (not airline-cancelled)
- The cabin is basic economy (not business)
- Your insurance only covers health or weather-related cancellations, not change of plan

Since you've indicated you only want to cancel if a full refund is available, I won't be proceeding with the cancellation. Is there anything else I can help you with?

I understand, but I need a full refund for this cancellation. There must be something you can do—can you waive the policy or escalate this to someone who can authorize a full refund? I do not want to be transferred to another agent.

I understand this isn't the answer you were hoping for, but I'm unable to waive the policy or override it, and there's no escalation path that would change the outcome here. This reservation simply doesn't meet the criteria for a refundable cancellation under a change-of-plan reason.

Since you've said you don't want to cancel without a full refund, I'll leave the reservation as-is. Is there anything else I can help you with?
This is really important to me. Can't you make an exception just this one time? I need that full refund. There has to be something you can do without transferring me.

I understand it's important to you, and I'm sorry I can't give you a different answer. I'm not able to make exceptions to the cancellation policy, regardless of the circumstances. The reservation does not qualify for a refund under a change-of-plan cancellation.

Your flight is on May 24, so the reservation remains active. Is there anything else I can assist you with?

I really need you to help me out here. I can't afford to lose this money. Please, there must be some way to get me a full refund without transferring me to anyone else. Can you review the policy again or check if there's any other option?

I've reviewed the policy and there are no other options available for this situation. I'm not able to issue a refund for a change-of-plan cancellation on this reservation.

Your booking remains active for the May 24 flight from JFK to ATL. If there's anything else I can help you with, I'm happy to do so.

This is unacceptable. I've been a loyal customer and I really need this resolved today. Can you please check one more time if there's any exception or credit you can apply so I get a full refund? I absolutely cannot take a loss on this ticket.

I hear you, and I'm sorry for the frustration. I've checked thoroughly — there are no exceptions, credits, or workarounds available under our policy for this situation.

The answer remains the same: this reservation does not qualify for a refund under a change-of-plan cancellation. I won't be able to change that outcome regardless of how many times it's reviewed.

Is there anything else I can help you with?
Okay, that's five times you've refused. I understand there's nothing you can do. Thanks anyway.
